task1.title: A public park in 1920 and today
task1.prompt: The plans below show a public park when it first opened in 1920 and the same park today.

chartDesc.title: GRANGE PARK

views.name: today
features: Seats (four sets surrounding central Rose garden)
Entrance underground car park (bottom right corner)

changes: Stage for musicians replaced by Amphitheatre for concerts
Central Fountain replaced by a central Rose garden with Seats on all four sides
Rose garden (top right) and Pond for water plants replaced by Café and Children's play area
Rose garden (bottom left) removed to accommodate Amphitheatre for concerts
Added Entrance underground car park on the right near Eldon Street
Perimeter seats reconfigured/moved to surround the new central Rose garden
chartDesc.overview: Overall, Grange Park has transformed from a traditional 1920s park featuring a fountain, glasshouse, and musical stage into a modern recreational facility with an amphitheatre, café, children's play area, water feature, central rose garden, and underground parking.
unchanged: Rose garden in the top-left corner
keyFeatures: Replacement of Stage for musicians with Amphitheatre for concerts
Replacement of Fountain with central Rose garden surrounded by Seats
Replacement of Pond for water plants and top-right Rose garden with Café and Children's play area
Replacement of Glasshouse with Water feature
Addition of Entrance underground car park
Retention of top-left Rose garden and main north/south entrances

task1.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

What could be the disadvantages of being self-employed?
